gloss: to hasten; to quicken; to bring forward

definitions.gloss: to bring forward; to move up
definitions.explanation: To reschedule something to an earlier time.
To make something happen faster or accelerate a process.

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}を{一時間|いちじかん}{早|はや}めた。
examples.english: We moved up the departure by one hour.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}を{早|はや}めて{駅|えき}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: I quickened my pace and headed to the station.

examples.japanese: ストレスは{老化|ろうか}を{早|はや}める。

notes:
{早|はや}める is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). The intransitive pair is {早|はや}まる (to be brought forward, to quicken).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{早|はや}めている indicates an ongoing action of hastening something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予定|よてい}を{早|はや}める - to move up a schedule
- {足|あし}を{早|はや}める - to quicken one's pace
- {歩|あゆ}みを{早|はや}める - to quicken one's steps
- {死|し}を{早|はや}める - to hasten death

PARTICLE PATTERN:
- [noun]を{早|はや}める - to hasten/bring forward [noun]
